text:
Bitcoin staged a technical breakout past the $63,000 mark on Friday morning, trading near $63,800 to record a 10% gain since the start of July. The surge was accelerated by the liquidations of $79.5 million in short positions within a 24-hour window, establishing a firm defensive base as spot ETFs recorded their first significant positive flow streak in eight weeks ($510 million over three days).

Macro headwinds softened as international crude prices cooled and Middle East geopolitical tensions showed initial signs of easing. U.S. 10-year Treasury yields consolidated near 4.54% as fixed-income markets paused ahead of the Humphrey-Hawkins testimony by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and next Tuesday's critical June CPI report. This marginal relief in yields and stable dollar pricing has cleared the path for digital assets, although the broader market remains in "Extreme Fear" at 23, awaiting structural verification of a dovish Fed pivot.
